node.title: Clean-endpoint linear unit-resultant gate
node.statement: For the clean two-sided weld WB-(X-x_0)=QK, choose parameter infinity so q_inf=[z^m]Q has degree rho and q_inf(x_0) is nonzero. Then Res_z(Q,W)Res_z(Q,B)=q_inf^(deg_z W+deg_z B)(X-x_0)^m. The exceptional valuations split exactly as ord Res(Q,B)=1 and ord Res(Q,W)=m-1; all remaining resultant factors are supported on q_inf. Both B and W are parameter-dependent, K is nonzero, and deg_z K=deg_z W+deg_z B-m. Thus B has parameter degree strictly between zero and m and, away from the infinity fibre, norm with one simple zero.
